summary: Full backend + frontend regression for MobileMistri theme refresh (WHITE + #002FA7 royal blue + Outfit font) and newly-added 'Other brand' + 'Other model (specify)' flow. Updated pytest suite (17 tests) all pass. Playwright verified home, /book, /brand/apple, /city/delhi and admin end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: content.py has a runtime loop at module bottom appending 'Other model (specify)' to every brand — works, but inlining the model in each brand dict would be clearer and avoid a side-effect on import.
server.py uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan context manager.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard. Set explicit origins in prod env.
enquiry_email_html still hardcodes old #0B1B3D navy + #FF5A00 orange — out of sync with new #002FA7 theme (cosmetic only).
InlineEnquiryForm does not enforce custom_model when Other-model selected (empty custom_model silently sends 'Other model (specify)' as model). Soft validation recommended.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added 9-brand check + 'other' brand + custom-model tests for enquiries and bookings)
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_* enquiries + 2 TEST_* bookings in MongoDB via pytest and Playwright flows (visible in admin dashboard).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login testids are admin-login-email / admin-login-password / admin-login-submit (NOT admin-email-input). Book-page brand cards testid is book-brand-{slug}, models are book-model-{modelName}, custom model input is book-custom-model. Inline enquiry form testids prefixed inline-inquiry-*. EnquirySheet custom model input is enquiry-custom-model. Stats strip labels are 'Repairs Done', 'on-site ETA' (not 'Avg ETA'), 'Genuine Parts', 'Cities Live', 'Avg Rating' — the requirement 'Avg ETA' wording is slightly different but functional stat strip exists with 5 metrics. Hero bg is white rgb(255,255,255), H1 font is Outfit, 126 elements use #002FA7 blue. CTA section with blue bg present. All 9 brands (including 'other') returned by /api/content, every brand's models list ends with 'Other model (specify)'. Enquiry/booking POST accepts brand='other' and arbitrary model string.
